description.narrative: It is proposed to reflect the financial markets and intermediation related support to be provided by the restructured project with the PDO revision. This revision is intended to increase focus on the effectiveness and impact of supported financial sector reforms, thereby promoting resilience, sustainable growth and stability in financial intermediation economywide. To help sustain CBE's financial health, establishing functional financial markets is crucial. Improved market functionality not only supports CBE but also contributes to the overall resilience of the banking system. Considering the significant progress achieved in fostering financial stability and considering the reduced funding available within the FSSP, the project has been restructured to address new priorities. This revision is intended to increase focus on the effectiveness and impact of financial sector reforms, thereby promoting sustainable growth and stability in financial intermediation economywide.The revision also introduces changes to the scope and costs under Component 1. All undisbursed financing linked to Performance-Based Conditions (PBCs) and Performance-Based Results (PBRs) allocated for the recapitalization of the Commercial Bank of Ethiopia (CBE), will be cancelled and the component will be renamed “Strengthening Core Financial Market Functionality and Institutional Effectiveness of Supervisory Oversight,” with a revised allocation of US$42 million. The restructuring reflects a more targeted focus on strengthening core financial market operations, including improving liquidity in money and foreign exchange markets, enhancing supervisory oversight of the banking sector and national payment and settlement systems, and supporting the establishment of an independent insurance regulatory authority thereby allowing the National Bank of Ethiopia (NBE) to concentrate on its core central banking functions. In addition, two new Performance-Based Conditions, with a combined value of US$40 million, will be introduced to support reforms in high-impact areas, particularly core financial market operations and supervisory effectiveness. These measures are intended to strengthen strategic prioritization and resource allocation within NBE, while reinforcing its role in promoting financial sector development and maintaining stability.Summary to be revised
To improve basic functionality of core financial markets, strengthen supervisory oversight, and expand efficient and accessible financial services across Ethiopia
